<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0 -->

# iru_library_item (Data Source)

Reads one existing Library Item's membership metadata in a Blueprint by exact UUID. Does not expose assignment-node placement, mutate membership, or collect device/status/activity data.

Supply an existing Blueprint UUID and the exact Library Item UUID expected in
that Blueprint. The documented list endpoint is Blueprint-scoped; this is not a
tenant-wide Library inventory lookup. Missing membership produces a diagnostic.
Names and first-match selection are not supported.

All pages are checked before returning a result. Pagination is restricted to
the configured tenant origin and listing endpoint, with a two-minute overall
timeout, 100-page and 10,000-item safety bounds. Repeated pages/UUIDs and unsafe
pagination URLs produce diagnostics. Read retries and redirect refusal follow
the provider client policy.

Only ID/name metadata is returned. The API list does not provide assignment-node
placement; membership here does not establish a particular Assignment Map node.
No assignment mutation, enrollment secret, device status or activity is managed.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUIDs: replace with an existing Blueprint and one of its Library Items.
data "iru_library_item" "selected" {
  blueprint_id    = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  library_item_id = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
}

output "library_item_name" {
  value = data.iru_library_item.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) Existing Blueprint UUID whose Library Item list is searched.
- `library_item_id` (String) Exact Library Item UUID expected in that Blueprint.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical Library Item UUID.
- `name` (String) Library Item display name.
